$comment: High/critical advisories reviewed and temporarily accepted by scripts/audit-check.mjs. Each entry expires; after that date CI fails again until it is re-reviewed. Only add advisories that cannot reach the shipped web bundle and have no patched version.

exceptions.reason: Build-time only (@expo/cli > @expo/code-signing-certificates); not in the browser bundle. The app never verifies RSA signatures. No patched version published yet.

Only Expo CLI's own copy (zod 3.x, @expo/cli), used at build time and not in the browser bundle. The app's zod is upgraded to the patched 4.6.7; this exception does not cover it. No patched 3.x release exists.
